metadata.description: The Sloosh plugins for Claude: product images, ad variants, product videos, Sloosh Spaces and launch films, plus a Shopify pack for catalog images, launch ads and product page videos.

plugins.name: sloosh
plugins.description: Create product images, ad variants and short product videos, run published Sloosh Spaces from chat, and direct a product launch film with Remotion in a coding agent. The assistant asks for your approval before any paid work.

plugins.name: sloosh-shopify
plugins.description: Catalog images, launch ads with copy and product page videos for the products in a Shopify store, made with Sloosh from a saved brand kit. Reads products only and never changes the store. The assistant asks for your approval before any paid work.
